testCase:
D-01: A calendar popup with a read-only field
Goal: Set the departure date to 14 February 2027.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-01/
STEP 2: Click "Departure date"
STEP 3: Click "Next month" until the calendar shows February 2027
STEP 4: Click "14 February 2027"
STEP 5: Verify "Departure date set: 14 February 2027" is visible

plan.title: D-01: Set departure using calendar popup

steps.note: Open the read-only field's picker, navigate to February 2027, and select 14 February.
Verify the requested departure date was set.

reasoning: This tests setting a departure date through a calendar popup whose field is read-only. The date-picker step opens the calendar, navigates to February 2027, and selects the requested day before checking the confirmation.
